title: Diagnostic PyTorch profiler comparison: N=16/K=256 warp4 versus warp1
method: B1 block, K=1, padded attention, 32 output tokens
limits: These are profiler-instrumented diagnostics, not comparable latency measurements.
Logical aten operator and underlying CUDA kernel events are hierarchical; do not sum them as independent time.
Both runs had the same cycle count, draft tokens, and accepted tokens; the profile does not measure multiple sessions.
